title: Ethiopian churches keep the Book of Enoch in their canon

tellings.quote: In fact in the fourth around the 4th century uh AD the Tawaho Orthodox Christians and the beta Israel Jew Jewish community in Ethiopia incorporated the book of Enoch into their canon.

plain: The Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text left out of most Bibles, was taken into the holy scriptures of the Tewahedo Orthodox Christians and the Beta Israel Jewish community of Ethiopia around the 4th century AD. The filmmaker and researcher Tim Alberino tells Michels this, drawing on the book in the translation by R. H. Charles. He raises it to show that the book's stories, which matter to his interest in ancient giants, were long treated as sacred.
